content: MVR-xchange protocol (mvrdevelopment/tools + gdtf.eu spec): TCP mode uses mDNS (_mvrxchange._tcp.local.) for discovery, direct peer-to-peer TCP; WebSocket mode uses central relay server with standard DNS. Message types: MVR_JOIN, MVR_LEAVE, MVR_COMMIT, MVR_REQUEST, MVR_NEW_SESSION_HOST, JSON-encoded over WebSocket, binary-wrapped over TCP. No documented authentication, encryption, or file validation in the spec itself -- trust/validation is left to implementers.
